selection.cells: is_primary_data and a blood tissue label

result.scoreDefinition: interferonScore: mean over the 18 interferon genes a store measures of log2(CPM + 1) in a donor-by-sample-by-coarse-type pseudobulk; interferonZScore: the same genes' log2(CPM + 1) z-scored against the store's healthy donors of the coarse type (earliest samples, at least 20 cells, at least 3 donors) and averaged over the genes that vary among them; the library is the sum of the stored RNA_nCounts; summaries use each donor's earliest sample and pseudobulks of at least 20 cells

cellScoreBins.definition: each cell's log2(CPM + 1) of its summed interferon gene counts, counted per pseudobulk into bins of this width from zero; the last bin also holds higher values; cells without a library are not counted

excludedStores.szabo_2019_single_cell_transcriptomics_s: T cells only, rested or activated
excludedStores.guerreromurillo_2024_cd19_carpos_carneg_: T cells of CAR T cell products
excludedStores.rodriguezubreva_2022_activated_pbmcs_twi: activated PBMCs without a stimulation label

result.cellTypeMap: blood_cell_type (experiments/runtime/annotations.py), with mast cells as Granulocytes and malignant cells unassigned
